site.title: Autodidact
site.intro: Learn on your own terms. Pick a subject and work through it one step at a time.

subjects.name: Fundamentals of Programming
subjects.description: Program flow, functions, recursion, pointers, and data types.

subjects.name: Data Structures and Algorithms
subjects.description: Lists, trees, graphs, sorting, and the cost of each operation.
subjects.keywords: dsa ds algo algorithms data structure list tree graph sort

chapters.title: Fundamentals, Asymptotic Notations and Time Optimization

traces.name: Floyd's cycle detection
traces.description: Find a cycle with two pointers. Then find the node where the cycle starts. The proof is on the page.
traces.keywords: floyd tortoise hare slow fast loop cycle detect linked list start

traces.name: Josephus problem
traces.description: Remove every k-th person from a circular linked list. Compare the result with the recurrence and the closed form.
traces.keywords: josephus survivor circle elimination circular list k skip

traces.name: Address of an element in a 2D or 3D array
traces.description: Count the elements before A[i][j][k]. See the skipped planes, lines, and elements in an array view and in memory. Choose row-major or column-major order.
traces.keywords: array address 2d 3d two dimensional three dimensional row major column major offset index base element size memory layout

traces.name: Reverse a singly linked list
traces.description: Trace the recursive function call by call. Watch each link turn around as the calls return.
traces.keywords: reverse reversal invert singly one way list pointer recursion

traces.name: Insert a node between two nodes of a doubly linked list
traces.description: Follow each pointer change that puts a new node between its two neighbors. Choose the position in the list.
traces.keywords: dll two way list insert add node between prev next pointers

traces.name: Build a full binary tree from preorder and postorder
traces.description: Watch the preorder and postorder ranges split at each call. See the tree grow, the call stack, and the formula for the split.
traces.keywords: construct build reconstruct rebuild binary tree preorder postorder traversal full tree

traces.name: Count the insertion orders that build a BST
traces.description: Count how many insertion orders give one fixed binary search tree. Watch the recursion combine the subtrees with T(n) = T(n1) · T(n2) · (n1 + n2)! / (n1! · n2!).
traces.keywords: binary search tree bst insertion order permutation permutations sequences count how many different orders same tree combinations binomial interleave shuffle

traces.name: AVL tree rotations
traces.description: See how insert and delete break the balance and how the four rotations (LL, RR, LR, RL) repair it. Hard examples, balance factors, and a formula panel.
traces.keywords: avl balanced balance factor rotation rotate ll rr lr rl single double insert delete bst height

traces.name: Order-statistic tree: Select and Rank
traces.description: Store the subtree size in each node. Then find the i-th smallest key, or the position of a key, in O(h) time. Two versions of Rank: bottom-up and top-down.
traces.keywords: order statistic select rank kth smallest os tree size augmented bst

traces.name: Red-black tree insertion
traces.description: Insert a red node, then fix the colors. Follow the four cases: the root, a red uncle, a black uncle with a bend, and a black uncle with a line. Hard examples and a formula panel.
traces.keywords: red black rb tree rbt insert insertion recolor uncle case 1 2 3 rotation fix

traces.name: Bubble sort
traces.description: Watch neighbors swap as the largest values move to the right. Choose the version with or without the early-exit flag. Compare the counts with the formulas.
traces.keywords: bubble sort swap adjacent flag early exit

traces.name: Insertion sort
traces.description: Hold the key aside, slide larger values to the right, and drop the key into the free place. Choose linear or binary search for the place. Compare the counts with the formulas.
traces.keywords: insertion sort key shift binary search

traces.name: Merge sort
traces.description: Split the range, sort each half, and merge the halves through a tmp array. See the call stack, the pointers i, j, k, and the comparison count against the best and worst cases.
traces.keywords: merge sort divide conquer merge two sorted halves tmp temporary array stable recursion

traces.name: QuickSort
traces.description: Watch partition split the array around a pivot. Choose the partition style and the input. See the call stack and the comparison count.
traces.keywords: quick sort partition pivot lomuto hoare divide conquer

subjects.name: Formal Languages and Automata
subjects.description: Finite automata, regular languages, context-free grammars, and Turing machines.
subjects.keywords: fla toc automata dfa nfa grammar turing language

subjects.name: Digital Design
subjects.description: Logic gates, combinational and sequential circuits, and state machines.
subjects.keywords: logic circuit gates flip flop dd

subjects.name: Computer Architecture
subjects.description: Processor design, pipelines, the memory hierarchy, and cache.
subjects.keywords: ca cpu pipeline cache memory organization

subjects.name: Operating Systems
subjects.description: Processes, scheduling, synchronization, memory, and file systems.

subjects.name: Statistics
subjects.description: Probability, distributions, estimation, and hypothesis tests.

subjects.name: Artificial Intelligence
subjects.description: Search, logic, probabilistic reasoning, and learning.
